Job Summary**

The COORDINATOR SH NGANJUK will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the company's Social, Health, and Safety (SH) programs within the Nganjuk facility, ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations.

Job Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive SH policies, procedures, and programs in accordance with PT Japfa Food Indonesia standards and relevant local and national regulations.
* Conduct regular SH risk assessments, identify potential hazards, and implement corrective actions to mitigate risks.
* Lead and facilitate SH training programs for all employees, including new hires, on topics such as emergency procedures, safe work practices, and hazardous material handling.
* Investigate all incidents, accidents, and near-misses, determine root causes, and develop preventative measures to avoid recurrence.
* Prepare and submit accurate SH reports to management and regulatory bodies as required.
* Collaborate with various departments to integrate SH considerations into operational processes and decision-making.
* Ensure the availability and proper maintenance of safety equipment and personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Conduct regular SH audits and inspections to ensure continuous compliance and identify areas for improvement.
* Stay updated on relevant SH legislation, industry best practices, and new technologies.
* Act as a primary point of contact for SH-related matters with employees, management, and external stakeholders.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a Social, Health, and Safety role, preferably within a manufacturing or food processing environment.
* Proven knowledge of Indonesian SH regulations and standards.
* Strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies and incident investigation techniques.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Certification in Occupational Health and Safety (e.g., K3 Umum) is highly desirable.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Nganjuk, Indonesia.

PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities
* Safely operate a reach truck to load, unload, stack, and retrieve finished goods (FG-3) from various warehouse locations.
* Perform daily pre-operation checks on the reach truck and report any defects or malfunctions immediately.
* Transport FG-3 products to designated storage areas and loading docks according to company procedures.
* Ensure accurate inventory placement and retrieval by scanning and verifying product codes.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area, including the reach truck and surrounding storage zones.
* Adhere to all safety regulations, company policies, and traffic rules within the warehouse.
* Assist with manual material handling tasks as needed.
* Participate in periodic inventory counts and stock verification activities.
* Communicate effectively with supervisors, team members, and other departments regarding material movement.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience as a reach truck driver, preferably with FG-3 or similar products.
* Valid certification or license to operate a reach truck.
* Strong understanding of warehouse safety procedures and practices.
* Ability to read and follow instructions accurately.
* Good physical stamina and ability to lift heavy objects when required.
* Excellent hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in material handling.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
